text.content:
Rockerboy, terrorist, or both.

Role: Rockerboy
Affiliation: Samurai
Status: Missing since 2023
Known for: Long blamed for the 2023 bomb; a raid on Arasaka in 2013

The legendary frontman of Samurai, whose 2013 concert turned into a riot. That year he, Rogue and the Media Lyle Thompson went into Arasaka after Alt Cunningham, who had just written a program called Soulkiller.

Arasaka blamed the 2023 blast in its tower on Militech- and NUSA-backed terrorists led by Silverhand; the NUSA blamed Arasaka. Since Trace Santiago's exposé was finally believed in 2047, the country has held that Militech set off the bomb. Silverhand hasn't been seen since.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.16; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.02
